**Finding submitted — deviation on § 15.3 (Limitations of Liability).**

- **Mutuality:** already met — § 15.3(b) caps "the total liability for either Party," and § 15.3(a) excludes consequential/lost-profit damages mutually.
- **Cap basis:** fails fallback — 3% of the bill-of-materials value of Products delivered, measured cumulatively from the Effective Date, is not a 12-months'-fees cap and is well below any meaningful floor.
- **Carve-outs:** none — MSL's § 15.1 indemnities (IP infringement, regulatory non-compliance, warranty failure), confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct all sit inside that cap, which is walk-away territory.
- **Redline (fallback level):** single surgical replace in p0274 changing only the cap basis to fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim, plus a proviso carving out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct. Mutual structure and the rest of the sentence preserved verbatim.
- **Not flagged:** the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement § 15 ($25,000 cap and consequential-damages exclusion) limits IBM's liability to MSL and therefore runs in our favour.
